summary: BitSlice::split_at_mut incorrectly rejects mid == self.len(), including splitting an empty slice at zero. The fix makes the bounds check inclusive. The fix adds a detecting doctest in src/slice/api.rs, but prototype/mine.py only supports named unit/integration tests and rejects doctest names. No detecting unit/integration test was found; test is empty to retain a blocked result. The implementation reversal is exact and unique. No tests were run.
